## Progress

- Added pinned finite-stage datum selection and compatibility APIs in commits `6e471169d5` and `04008d8cf3`.
- Pinned final scalar-extension map witnesses in `54a22276b3`.
- Migrated canonical assembly, glued maps, chart factors, and gluing base-change consumers to pinned presentations in `5958d31dc8`.

## Issues

- `Pic0FiniteStageGluingDiagramIso.lean` lacks a direct `Pic0FiniteStageGluingBaseChange` import. Its presentation-native adapter is preserved as attempt `0001`; verification stalled in artifactless `Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionNaturality` after 17 minutes.
- LSP checks for DiagramIso were partial. No full `Pic0CriticalPath` or project-root build was completed, and hgraph synchronization was deferred.
- The pre-existing untracked `Pic0FiniteStageLegacyAdapter.lean` remains untouched.
- Other dirty ledger paths belong to concurrent Hartshorne, Milne, and Mumford runs. No concurrent files were staged or committed; the AJCR scope has no uncommitted authored changes.

## Why I Stopped

The objective is partly advanced. The main unstable finite-stage boundaries now expose verified witness-bearing APIs, but DiagramIso migration, final-base-change naturality, producer migration, and representability endpoints remain open.

## Next

Build `Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionNaturality` in isolation, then verify and commit the DiagramIso direct import and presentation adapter. Continue migrating legacy GlueData consumers through `P.presentation`, then address final naturality and producer obligations.
